policy: No full Strong's or TSK dataset becomes public until the source URL, license, commercial-use status, attribution requirements, parser quality, and review status are documented. Staged imports remain hidden until promoted.

source_candidates.title: OpenBible.info Bible Cross References
source_candidates.rights_status: Creative Commons Attribution License unless otherwise indicated.
source_candidates.license_summary: OpenBible states the data draws primarily from public-domain sources, especially Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, and licenses content under Creative Commons Attribution unless otherwise indicated. Import references only; do not import ESV quotations.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Commercial use allowed under CC BY attribution requirements for reference-pair data.
source_candidates.next_action: Continue promoting small reviewed batches only. Do not import the full dataset until attribution display, ordering, and quality workflow are complete.
source_candidates.public_import_scope: Limited reviewed reference-pair batches only; no ESV quotations, no rendered website text, and no full automated public import.

source_candidates.title: MetaV CrossRefIndex
source_candidates.rights_status: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 per local rights review.
source_candidates.license_summary: The repository describes CrossRefIndex as compiled from public-domain TSK tradition, but its distributed files carry CC BY-SA obligations.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Share-alike implications need acceptance before public import.
source_candidates.next_action: Keep as alternate path only; do not promote unless share-alike obligations are explicitly accepted.

source_candidates.title: STEPBible Data Repository
source_candidates.rights_status: CC BY 4.0 according to the current repository readme.
source_candidates.license_summary: STEPBible says the data may be included in software/publications without requesting permission, with credit to STEP Bible and notes for changes/corrections. Current tagged translation data identified in the repository is not a direct KJV word-to-Strong's mapping.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Promising, but exact files and attribution language must be reviewed before public import.
source_candidates.next_action: Use for lexicon/source comparison first. Do not use as the primary KJV mapping source until an exact KJV-tagged file is identified.

source_candidates.title: CrossWire KJV 1769 with Strong's Numbers and Morphology
source_candidates.rights_status: CrossWire KJV module with embedded Strong's numbers. Module documentation includes GPL distribution notes, general public license language, Crown-rights notes for the base KJV text, and multiple source acknowledgements.
source_candidates.license_summary: CrossWire documents embedded Strong's numbers with OT data from Bible Foundation and NT data from KJV2003. Use for hidden staging and parser work only until GPL/module attribution and base-text handling are approved.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Approved for local staging only; public app import requires project approval of redistribution obligations.
source_candidates.next_action: Run the OSIS staging importer against reviewed local source files. Promote only manually reviewed rows after obligations and attribution are documented.

source_candidates.title: Original Strong's Exhaustive Concordance Public-Domain Scan
source_candidates.rights_status: Likely public domain by publication age when an original pre-1931 edition is selected.
source_candidates.license_summary: Use as evidence and OCR verification source, not as an automatic structured import.
source_candidates.next_action: Select an exact scan, record publication data, spot-check OCR quality, and use it to verify lexicon entries.

source_candidates.title: e-Sword KJV+ Strong's Module Experience
source_candidates.rights_status: Reference only; do not import e-Sword modules or bundled data without explicit permission and redistribution terms.
source_candidates.license_summary: e-Sword demonstrates the desired user experience of KJV words with adjacent Strong's numbers. Its modules should be treated as modern app/module content, not as a public import source, unless written permission and license terms are documented.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Do not use for public import without written permission.
source_candidates.next_action: Use as a UX reference only. Build the app display from rights-cleared KJV-to-Strong mapping sources such as approved STEP/CrossWire-compatible data or a documented public-domain source.
